fullPassage: If cooking is as central to human identity, biology, and culture as the biological anthropologist Richard Wrangham suggests, it stands to reason that the decline of cooking in our time would have serious consequences for modern life, and so it has. Are they all bad? Not at all. The outsourcing of much of the work of cooking to corporations has relieved women of what has traditionally been their exclusive responsibility for feeding the family, making it easier for them to work outside the home and have careers. It has headed off many of the domestic conflicts that such a large shift in gender roles and family dynamics was bound to spark. It has relieved other pressures in the household, including longer workdays and overscheduled children, and saved us time that we can now invest in other pursuits. It has also allowed us to diversify our diets substantially, making it possible even for people with no cooking skills and little money to enjoy a whole different cuisine. All that's required is a microwave.

det.korean: 여성들의 독점적 책임이 '전통적으로' 가족을 먹이는 것이었다 → 부사 traditionally
det.analysis: has __________ been → 동사(been)를 수식하는 부사 자리. tradition(명사) → traditionally(부사)로 변환.

questions.passage: If cooking is as central to human identity, biology, and culture as the __________ (biology) anthropologist Richard Wrangham suggests, it stands to reason that the decline of cooking in our time would have serious consequences for modern life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: '생물학' 인류학자 → 명사(anthropologist)를 수식하는 형용사 biological
det.analysis: __________ anthropologist → 명사(anthropologist)를 수식하는 형용사 자리. biology(명사) → biological(형용사)로 변환.

questions.passage: If cooking is as central to human identity, biology, and culture as the biological anthropologist Richard Wrangham suggests, it __________ that the decline of cooking in our time would have serious consequences for modern life, and so it has. Are they all bad? Not at all. The outsourcing of much of the work of cooking to corporations has relieved women of what has traditionally been their exclusive responsibility for feeding the family, making it easier for them to work outside the home and have careers. It has headed off many of the domestic conflicts that such a large shift in gender roles and family dynamics was bound to spark. It has relieved other pressures in the household, including longer workdays and overscheduled children, and saved us time that we can now invest in other pursuits. It has also allowed us to diversify our diets substantially, making it possible even for people with no cooking skills and little money to enjoy a whole different cuisine. All that's required is a microwave.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요리가 핵심적이라면, 요리의 쇠퇴가 심각한 결과를 가져올 것이라는 점은 '당연하다'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① is bound to spark — ~을 촉발할 수밖에 없다 (본문 표현이나 it ___ that 구문 부적합)
✅ ② stands to reason — 당연하다, 이치에 맞다. it stands to reason that = ~은 당연하다 ←정답
❌ ③ is central to identity — 정체성에 핵심적이다 (본문 표현이나 it ___ that 구문 부적합)
❌ ④ has traditionally been — 전통적으로 ~이었다 (본문 표현이나 it ___ that 구문 부적합)
det.tip: stands to reason = 당연하다, 이치에 맞다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성별 역할과 가족 역학에서의 큰 변화가 촉발할 수밖에 없는 많은 가정 내 갈등을 막았다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① cooking skills and little money — 요리 기술과 적은 돈 (본문 표현이나 shift in의 목적어로 부적합)
❌ ② exclusive responsibility and careers — 독점적 책임과 직업 (본문 표현이나 shift 맥락에 부적합)
✅ ③ gender roles and family dynamics — 성별 역할과 가족 역학 ←정답
❌ ④ serious consequences and pressures — 심각한 결과와 압박 (본문 표현이나 shift 맥락에 부적합)
det.tip: gender roles and family dynamics = 성별 역할과 가족 역학
